abilities.name: Dragonqueen
abilities.description: After 1.25 seconds, transform into a dragon and gain 500 Health. While Dragonqueen is active, Alexstrasza's Basic Abilities are empowered, her Basic Attacks deal 143 damage and heal allied Heroes for 43 in an arc in front of her, and the duration of incoming Slows, Roots, and Stuns is reduced by 50%. Lasts 15 seconds.; 150; trait

fields.type: Transformation, Status effect / Physical Damage / Healing
fields.props: Attack Modifier, Channeled cast (stationary), CC-reduction, Splash, Stasis
fields.notes: Interrupting Dragonqueen during its cast puts it on a 10-second cooldown. Dragonqueen grants Alexstrasza a different set of Basic Abilities, which have independent cooldowns and are unaffected by Alexstrasza's Talents that interact with her base form Basic Abilities. When the Ability is successfully cast, and upon ending and transformation back to base form, Alexstrasza enters Stasis for 0.5 seconds. In addition to usual effects of Stasis, Alexstrasza is removed from the ground plane (disjoints certain projectiles), has no collision, cannot regenerate Health, Mana, Energy or Shields and cannot be seen on the minimap or revealed. Both current and maximum Health are increased upon successful transformation. When the Ability expires, only maximum Health is reduced back to normal. Dragonqueen's cooldown starts when the Ability is successfully cast.

abilities.name: Gift of Life
abilities.description: Sacrifice 15% of Alexstrasza's current Health, healing an ally for 150% of that amount. Passive Alextraza's Health regeneration is increased by 150% purpletext Dragonqueen: Breath of Life Cooldown greatly reduced and does not cost Health.

fields.notes: Passive Health regeneration bonus also affects Alexstrasza in her dragon form. Passive bonus directly increases Alexstrasza's base Health regeneration, meaning that calculations using the given percentage should be made multiplicatively with any modifiers affecting her Health regeneration.

abilities.name: Abundance
abilities.description: Plant a seed of healing that blooms after 3 seconds, healing nearby allied Heroes for 20% of their maximum Health. purpletext Dragonqueen: Preservation Heal area and amount greatly increased.

fields.notes: Target area is visible to enemies.

abilities.name: Flame Buffet
abilities.description: Launch a fireball, Burning enemies hit for 75 damage over 5.5 seconds. Hitting enemies that are already Burning deals 125 bonus damage upon impact, Slows them by 40% decaying over 2 seconds, and refunds the Mana cost. purpletext Dragonqueen: Wing Buffet Damage and Knockback enemies in an arc.

fields.props: Clamping, Damage over Time, Piercing Skillshot, Slow

abilities.name: Wing Buffet
abilities.description: Deal 162 damage to enemies in an area, knocking them back and Slowing them by 50% for 3 seconds.

fields.notes: The area starts at 3 radius and grows to its maximum radius over 0.3125 seconds.

abilities.name: Life-Binder
abilities.description: Bind Alexstrasa's life force with an allied Hero. Both she and her target are healed for 480 over 2 seconds. Afterward, the Hero with a lower percentage of health is set to the same Health percentage as the other Hero.

fields.notes: Life-Binder immediately ends, going on full cooldown, if either of the two linked Heroes dies, becomes Time Stopped, enters a Vehicle or hostile Stasis or otherwise becomes untargetable by friendly Abilities. The heal resolves normally if the target ally enters a friendly Stasis effect, like Ice-Block or Bunker. However, the Ability still ends if Alexstrasza herself enters Stasis through means other than her Dragonqueen transformation.

abilities.name: Cleansing Flame
abilities.description: After 1.25 seconds, take to the sky and drop fireballs at the position of your mouse cursor every 1.2 seconds for 6 seconds. Each fireball restores 300 Health to nearby allied Heroes, and deals 135 damage to nearby enemies. 2 seconds after dropping all fireballs, Alexstrasza lands at the position of your mouse cursor.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Channeled cast (stationary), Stasis
fields.notes: Interrupting Cleansing Flame during its cast period puts it on a 10-second cooldown. Cleansing Flame 's cooldown starts when the Ability is successfully cast. For the duration of the Ability, Alexstrasza is put in Stasis. In addition to the usual effects of Stasis, Alexstrasza is removed from the ground plane (disjoints certain projectiles), has no collision, cannot regenerate Health, Mana, Energy or Shields and cannot be seen on the minimap or revealed. Dragonqueen 's duration is paused during Cleansing Flame but its cooldowns are not.
